name: computer-use
description: Work with websites and macOS applications through their visual interfaces. Artemis provides the browser, native helper and current model.

interface.longDescription: Use Artemis Browser and macOS applications through observed controls and screenshots. The host provides a bundled native helper, per-application permissions, task ownership and a visible Stop control. Requires macOS and a model with image input.
defaultPrompt: Help me complete a task in a website or macOS application.
